title: Chapter 238: The Zerg'S Terrifying Counterattack
content:
Chapter 238: The Zerg'S Terrifying Counterattack

At the same time, one hundred Zerg queens who had been waiting for the opportunity launched an egg-laying attack on the Light Griffin Knights. One hundred against one hundred, no more, no less, just right!

As if the invisible and traceless magical spores ignored all the powerful defense measures of the Light Griffin Knights, entered their bodies, absorbed the extremely abundant energy and vitality in their bodies, and grew at an indescribable speed.

"Retreat!"

The leading Light Griffin Knight found something strange in his body and barely said three words, and could only concentrate all his energy to fight against the terrible unknown existence in his body.

The giant Light Griffin, which was at least five-star in strength, seemed to understand the words of the Light Griffin Knight. They all turned right and flew high, trying to get out of contact with the Zerg army.

However, Wu Qing disagreed!

The one hundred Zerg queens who had just launched an egg-laying attack directly sprayed out one hundred trapping nets, which caught the giant Light Griffin and a large number of ordinary Light Griffins!

The Light Griffin, which had a particularly strong flying ability, was restrained by the trapping net and could barely keep flying, but the speed had become very slow!

"Pah, pah, pah...!"

The Griffin Knight on the back of the giant Griffin could not stop the self-destruction of the self-destructing parasites that were growing rapidly in its body. Its body exploded one after another and exploded into a streak of white light!

Only the whole set of equipment remained on the back of the five-star giant Griffin.

The combat power of these Griffin Knights, with the blessing of some powerful divine arts, seemed to exceed the scope of five-star, but their own strength was still five-star.

A five-star Zerg Queen attacked five-star enemies. Even if these enemies were extremely powerful, it would not be a problem to kill them with one blow. It just took a little more time.

If the Zerg Queen had not been upgraded to five-star urgently, it might be a bit troublesome to kill these one hundred powerful Griffin Knights with four-star strength.

Even if their attack could be interrupted, it would be very likely that they would run away.

In the center of the Zerg army square, nine hundred five-star Zerg destroyers attacked by the light arrows shot by the Griffin Knights had a huge hole on each of them!

Even though a two-star Zerg puppy blocked the arrow for them, they still suffered huge damage. The Zerg puppy that blocked the arrow turned into light and disappeared.

The purification and annihilation energy contained in the light arrow has exceeded the five-star category. The defense ability of the Zerg Destroyer, which evolved from the Zerg cockroach, cannot resist it under the support of the five-star strength.

Nearly half of the five-star Zerg Destroyers were directly misfired, and the damage they suffered affected their attacks.

Fortunately, the super self-healing recovery ability inherited from the Zerg cockroach by the Zerg Destroyer played a huge role.

The injured Zerg Destroyer used the five-star strength to fully mobilize energy to recover from the injury. The body tissues that completely disappeared due to the purification and annihilation damage on their bodies were regenerated and recovered at a speed visible to the naked eye.

The Light Griffin Knights sent by the alien human army knocked down nearly half of the super firepower of the Zerg army with one blow, and the combat goal was half completed!

But these 100 powerful light griffin knights lost their lives because of this. I don’t know if this deal is worthwhile for the alien army.

Wu Qing temporarily ignored the injured five-star Zerg destroyers. There are still nearly 500 five-star Zerg destroyers that can attack normally, which will not affect the battle situation for the time being.

Now the light griffins of the aliens want to turn around and escape, and Wu Qing doesn’t want to let them go!

Without the light griffin knights, the light griffins, which are less than 30,000 in number, have no meaning to continue to attack the Zerg army square.

Including the five-star giant light griffins that lost their knights, they all want to break away from contact with the Zerg army and fly back to the main camp of the alien army.

These light griffins with very fast flying speed, if they are released like this, they will escape, and the Zerg will have no way to deal with them.

Now that they have such a good opportunity to deliver themselves, Wu Qing must seize it anyway and cannot let it go.

Wu Qing also sent out all the Zerg dragons that he had been reluctant to use to fight head-on. The Zerg dragons did not attack the Bright Griffins from the front, but learned to take a detour from the Bright Griffins, and went around behind the Bright Griffins, blocking the Bright Griffins' retreat.

The Bright Griffins did not want to run, but nearly half of their companions were caught in the trap net of the Zerg Queen. It was already very good to be able to stay in the air, and they could not fly fast at all.

The other half could not abandon their companions and escape alone, so they were surrounded together.

The Zerg Hydralisks in the Zerg army square came out of the formation and launched a fierce attack on the Bright Griffins in the air.

Wu Qing was worried that the five-star giant griffins would counterattack and cause casualties, so he asked the Zerg Queen to add parasitic control to them all. Regardless of whether they could be controlled or not, at least they would have no energy to fight back.

Seeing that they were surrounded, the group of light griffins immediately broke out in the direction of the Zerg dragons, and fought with nearly 50,000 Zerg dragons led by 100 five-star Zerg dragons, with the lowest strength being two-star.

The armies of other races in the local camp below quickly evacuated to the surrounding areas, leaving combat space for the Zerg dragons, hydralisks and the light griffins of the alien human army.

Nearly 100,000 Zerg hydralisks in the Zerg army square went out to chase the group of light griffins flying slowly in the air, beating the light griffins like fireworks in the sky, constantly turning into light in the air.

The main camp of the alien human army wanted to come to the rescue, but it was powerless. The surroundings were all local troops. The only gap was now blocked by the Zerg army with ultra-long-range firepower, and they could not rush through.

All the forces that could be sent out had been sent out, and now they could only watch the once invincible flying army struggling to death under the siege of the Zerg army.

"Prepare to break out!"

The highest commander of this alien human army, the human knight in gorgeous armor, did not say much and directly ordered a breakout.

He only needed to issue an order, and the specific way to break out would be organized by his own professionals.

To command such a powerful army, the high-level commander only needed to make decisions at the strategic level. There was a mature system for how to fight specifically, and he did not need to pay much attention.

Given the current situation faced by the alien human army, it is not an easy task to successfully break out.

The trump cards of the powerful mage team, the heavy cavalry unit, the flying horde of the light griffin and the knight of the light griffin were lost one by one in the hands of the Zerg army.

If it was only the army of other races in the native camp that surrounded them, it would be easy for the alien army to break through.

But now there is a big enemy, the Zerg army, and it is not easy to break through and leave calmly. You must make some choices.

The main camp of the alien army is not attacked by the Zerg destroyers now, and the offensive of the besieged native camp army has weakened, giving the alien army the opportunity to quickly leave the front line.

The alien army used siege weapons and crossbowmen to suppress the besieged native camp army with firepower, and the melee troops quickly retreated and left the combat state.

Since we are ready to break through, we can't take away all the siege weapons and a large amount of logistical combat supplies. Now we can use them to our heart's content.

The fierce long-range firepower of the alien army made the local army dare not send troops to die. They could only watch the alien army, which still had nearly four million troops, shrinking its formation and starting to re-arrange its troops.

Wu Qing saw the actions of the alien army through the Zerg host and knew that they were either going to attack the Zerg army or preparing to retreat, or attacking the Zerg army while organizing some troops to retreat.

"Are they preparing to fight hard? Or are they preparing to retreat temporarily?"

"The Zerg army is really strong! It's just that the troops are a little less, otherwise we can wipe out this domineering alien army today!"

"I hope the armies of all races can cooperate with the Zerg army and try to eliminate as many enemies as possible!"

"..."

As soon as the alien army moved, everyone saw some signs.

After discovering this situation, the local army that besieged the alien army gave up the attack and began to deploy troops and strengthen defense to prepare for the fierce attack of the alien army.

Many local camp troops that did not participate in the battle but only assisted began to set up a siege defense line in the outermost direction except the direction of the Zerg army.

Those races that are good at digging fortifications have begun to dig holes and ditches and set up various obstacles in order to play a role in preventing the escape of the alien human army.

Wu Qing certainly did not want to let these alien human troops leave. He saw the Zerg flying dragons and light griffins still fighting in the air, and felt that this group of light griffins was holding up too many Zerg troops.

Ten Zerg explosive mosquitoes that had quietly risen to five stars flew out from the back of the Zerg flying dragon group, first flew to a high altitude, and then directly entered an accelerated dive state, rushing towards the most densely populated area of light griffins!

The ordinary light griffins only saw a residual image falling from the sky, and after several loud noises of "boom...!", there were only a few light griffins left in the sky wailing!

The huge explosion impacted many places, causing the Zerg Mutalisks and Zerg Hydralisks that were attacking the Bright Griffins to enter a defensive state.

The local camp troops that were close finally felt the terrifying power of the five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquito. The explosion at such a long distance made them feel a strong sense of oppression that they could lose their lives at any time, and many people were injured.

The few Bright Griffins that survived in the sky were killed by Zerg Mutalisks and Zerg Hydralisks, and disappeared in light.
